    Corporate Profile


    申 洲 國 際 集 團 控 股 有 限 公 司（「申 洲 國 際」） Shenzhou Inter national Group Holdings Limited (“Shenzhou
    及 其 附 屬 公 司（統 稱「本 集 團」）為 全 球 最 大         International”) and its subsidiaries (collectively the “Group”) is one of
    的 縱 向 一 體 化 針 織 製 造 商 之 一，主 要 以 代 工      the largest vertically integrated knitwear manufacturers in the world.
    (OEM)及 委 託 設 計(ODM)相 結 合 方 式 為 客 戶       The Group is principally engaged in the manufacturing of high-end
    製造質量上乘的針織品。                              knitwear for the customers by the method of combining OEM and
                                             ODM.


    本集團的布料生產基地位於中國寧波市經                       The Group’s fabrics production base is located in Ningbo Economic &
    濟 技 術 開 發 區 和 越 南 西 寧 省，並 策 略 性 地 在      Technical Development Zone, the People’s Republic of China (“PRC”)
    中 國 寧 波 市 及 安 慶 市、越 南 胡 志 明 市 及 西 寧      and Tây Ninh Province, Vietnam, and the Group has strategically
    省 和 柬 埔 寨 金 邊 市 設 有 製 衣 工 廠，在 上 海、       set up garment factories in Ningbo and Anqing of China, Ho Chi
    香 港 及 大 阪 均 設 有 銷 售 辦 事 處 或 代 表 處。現      Minh City and Tây Ninh Province of Vietnam and Phnom Penh of
    時 本 集 團 員 工 逾95,820人，廠 房 佔 地 面 積 逾       Cambodia. The Group also established sales offices or representative
    617萬 平 方 米，建 築 面 積 逾456萬 平 方 米，各         offices in Shanghai, Hong Kong and Osaka. The Group currently
    類針織服裝產量約4.9億件。                           has over 95,820 employees. The area of the factories is over 6.17
                                             million sq.m. and floor area covers over 4.56 million sq.m., which can
                                             produce various knitwear of about 490,000,000 pieces.


    本 集 團 主 要 生 產 針 織 運 動 類 用 品、休 閒 服 裝      The Group focuses on producing knitted sportswear, casual wear
    及內衣服裝，主要客戶包括NIKE、UNIQLO、                 and lingerie wear for major international renowned clients including
    ADIDAS及PUMA等國際知名品牌客戶。產品                  NIKE, UNIQLO, ADIDAS and PUMA. The products’ markets are

    場。                                       the US.

     二 零 二 二 年 一 月 一 日，區 域 全 面 經 濟 夥 伴 關      On 1 January 2022, the Regional Comprehensive Economic

        水，最 小 化 了 這 類 產 品 對 環 境 的                   water consumption, which minimizes the pressure on

assessment on the recoverability of the trade
receivables and the sufficiency of provision
for impairment based on information
including the credit profile of different
customers, ageing of the trade receivables,
historical settlement records, subsequent
settlement status, expected timing and

balances, and on-going trading relationships
with the relevant customers. Management
also considered forward-looking information

   本集團於各報告期末計量其按公允值                            The Group measures its equity investments at fair value at
   計量的權益投資。公允值為市場參與者                           the end of each reporting period. Fair value is the price that
   間於計量日期進行的有序交易中，出售                           would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability
   資產所收取或轉讓負債所支付之價格。                           in an orderly transaction between market participants at the
   公允值計量假設出售資產或轉讓負債                            measurement date. The fair value measurement is based
   的交易於該資產或負債的主要市場，或                           on the presumption that the transaction to sell the asset or
   在無主要市場的情況下，則於對該資產                           transfer the liability takes place either in the principal market
   或負債最有利的市場進行。本集團必須                           for the asset or liability, or in the absence of a principal market,
   可於該主要市場或最有利市場進行交                            in the most advantageous market for the asset or liability.
   易。資產或負債的公允值乃採用市場參                           The principal or the most advantageous market must be
   與者為資產或負債定價時所用的假設                            accessible by the Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability
   計量，即假設市場參與者按其最佳經濟                           is measured using the assumptions that market participants
   利益行事。                                       would use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that
                                               market participants act in their economic best interest.
